    @NoGC
  public fun token(value: Token): Token
    =
      MethodCall sameToken
        Call keepToken
          Var value
    @NoGC
  public fun wide(value: Wide): Wide
    =
      MethodCall copyWide
        Call keepWide
          Var value
    @NoGC
  public fun sum(value: Wide): Long
    =
      Call total
        Var value
    @NoGC

        Var value
